## Episode Thesis

This is a special episode of Sparpodden featuring an interview with Sweden's Finance Minister Elisabeth Svantesson, covering macro and policy themes rather than stock picks: Trump-driven trade-war unpredictability and its ~SEK 160bn drag on Swedish GDP, inflation coming down (targeting lowest in the EU), ISK/kapitalförsäkring taxation, mortgage interest deductions, housing supply, labour-market and AI disruption, electrification and nuclear power. Companies are named only illustratively (AI leaders, index-fund constituents, sponsor products), with no directional investment recommendations. Sweden's economy is framed as resilient with low sovereign debt, though Volvo Cars is flagged as struggling.
